name: Card
summary: Container for one connected piece of content, like an article or a project. With a native Figma slot for your own content.
use: Overviews of similar items in a grid.
avoid: One long text: use normal page content.
figmaProps: Show media / Show meta / Meta / Title / Supporting text / Show action
reactProps: Makes the whole card clickable through the title link.
behaviour: With href the whole card is clickable. The link sits on the title and is stretched over the card. An action is then not shown.
a11y: One link per clickable card. No separate "Read more" link next to it.
Media is decorative unless it holds information. Then give it alt text.
content: Title two lines at most. Text three lines at most.
do: Keep cards in a grid the same height.
dont: Several clickable elements inside a clickable card.
